messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we just crossed 25M monthly tokens and launch traffic smoothed out. To celebrate, there's a roaming coffee cart in the parking lot at 11:30 with free drinks ☕🎉
kevin: Woo!! 🎉 Oat milk please (and extra cinnamon)
olivia: Love this. Also put a tiny leaderboard on the corkboard by the kitchen — data looks wild. Sarah's little chart is the new office art.
ash: Can someone cover my desk for 10 mins? I want to do a 5-min demo at noon and ring a bell when things are green 🔔
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Production rollout completed: v2026.3.2 — no post-deploy errors reported ✅
sam: Can we get "I survived launch" stickers? I will wear mine with pride :sticker:
maria: I reserved a single parking spot for a raffle prize — raffle at 3pm in the lobby. Also massive kudos to infra for holding 99.98% latency SLO today, team.
kevin: Pics or it didn't happen. ☝️
olivia: I'll post a cake photo in #general in 10. It's banana-chocolate — scientifically neutral and universally loved.
nash: Tiny contest: I hid a miniature flag on my desk. First person to find it gets first dibs on the raffle ticket if they promise to adopt a plant for the office jungle.
sam: Karaoke tonight? React with :microphone: to vote. Low-pressure, high-silliness.
maria: Also small ask — if you created any quick eval prompts during the launch, drop them in the docs channel. Short ones help us track regressions. Thank you all, lovely work today ❤️
